name: speaker-map
desc: Free, open-source speaker diarization for Windows — see who spoke when, rename voices, export tracks. 100 MB portable, offline, MIT.
features: ✅ **Who spoke when** — recordings split into speaker turns with a color timeline you can trust
✅ **Local diarization models** — ONNX pipelines run on your machine; interviews never reach a cloud
✅ **Speaker renaming** — click a lane, type a real name, and every turn, export and transcript follows
✅ **Merge and split turns** — fix the model's mistakes by hand and the labels propagate
✅ **Per-speaker export** — each voice written as its own audio track and transcript file
✅ **Batch interviews** — a folder of recordings diarized overnight with consistent naming
✅ **100 MB self-contained exe** — runtime bundled, models download separately, offline after that, MIT
compare: | Feature | **speaker-map** | pyannote scripts | Cloud transcription | Audacity manual |
| Price | **Free, MIT** | Free, OSS | Paid per hour | Free, OSS |
| GUI turn correction | **Yes** | No | Partial | Manual labels
| Audio stays local | **Yes** | Yes | Upload | Yes
| Per-speaker track export | **Yes** | Scripted | Rare | No
| Portable, no install | **Yes, 100 MB** | Python env | Browser | Installer
faqQ: how to identify who spoke when in an interview recording offline?
faqA: Diarization usually lives in a research repo where a single dependency bump breaks the evening, and cloud services bill per hour of audio. speaker-map gives you a color timeline, one-click renaming and per-speaker track exports locally. It is a 100 MB portable exe, MIT, offline.
s1: Dark timeline (#121418, violet #C084FC): waveform with four colored speaker lanes, turn blocks labeled speaker 1 to 4, playhead at 12 minutes 40 seconds.
s2: Rename flow: lane context menu open with speaker 3 selected, text field typing Marina, propagation note reading updates 87 turns and 1 transcript.
s3: Export step: per-speaker checkboxes all on, track format WAV, transcript formats list showing txt and srt, summary chip reading 4 tracks written.
